checkpoint_precision: publisher BF16 checkpoint; automatic BF16 KV cache; no quantization
generation_choice_basis: Publisher sampling defaults; one fixed seed, medium thinking and 4096 total output tokens fixed before Qwen benchmark outputs; no search or test-driven changes.
prompt_policy: Unchanged source TD Test choice order and concatenation: Question: +Question+Choices:+combined A/B/C/D+The Answer is:. No answer, label, figure caption, extra instruction or system message. Full source question/all choices and image retained.

metric_policy.primary: native_td_final_character_accuracy: unchanged native TD generated_texts[i][-1], then AST-extracted difflib SequenceMatcher closest-choice mapping for prediction and source Answer label; original tie rule, no trim/lowercase/normalization.
separate_adaptations: adapted_full_text_closest_choice_accuracy uses full final assistant string and native Answer-derived target
adapted_full_text_released_label_accuracy uses full final assistant string and released Answer_label
strict_final_label_accuracy uses preregistered last-line A/B/C/D parser and released Answer_label
metric_policy.missing_policy: Every frozen test case in all denominators; missing/failed/empty predictions score0, no invented closest-choice fill; undefined native mapping and failed outputs disclosed.

paper_comparison: Fixed local zero-shot Qwen vision baseline on complete native clean2000 set and source TD question/choice strings. Qwen chat, image preprocessing, free generation and training differ from MedVInT. Match metric/output extraction and clean split before comparing; full-text metric is adapted, TE systems are not exact reproductions. Public pretraining exposure unknown.
pretraining_contamination: Unknown; local inference and shuffled choices cannot establish contamination-free performance.
